fields.value: Assistant Vice President with 16+ years of progressive experience across global investment banking, specializing in Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality, Risk & Controls, Regulatory Compliance, and Portfolio Governance. Proven expertise in designing and strengthening governance frameworks that enhance data integrity, improve control effectiveness, and ensure compliance with BCBS 239, GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and enterprise Data Management standards. Demonstrated success in leading independent KPI validation, Governance Risk Assessments, Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, Critical Data Elements (CDEs) governance, and Data Stewardship validation to improve governance accountability, audit readiness, and executive confidence in enterprise reporting. A trusted partner to senior stakeholders across Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Business functions, driving governance transformation, regulatory remediation, executive reporting, and reporting automation through Clarity PPM, SAP Business Intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions. Recognized for delivering measurable improvements in governance maturity, data quality, operational efficiency, and decision-making across complex global banking environments.
